messages:
Noah (Design): quick check on the trace viewer header layout. thinking to move correlation pill inline with metadata and make export a right-hand action. low-fi mock attached.
Tasha (Eng): inline pill is nicer when scrolling. question: should copy be a visible button or an inline chevron menu?
Ibrahim (PM): visible copy for permalink is priority. export can live in kebab. keep export labeled 'Export trace (.jsonl)' and include redaction toggle.
Riley (A11y): a11y items: 1) correlation pill needs aria-label 'Correlation ID, copy' and keyboard focus. 2) kebab menu must have aria-expanded state. 3) any hover-only controls need keyboard equivalents.
Noah (Design): microcopy: primary 'Copy permalink', secondary in kebab 'Download trace (may contain PII)'. tooltip: 'Copy correlation ID to clipboard'.
Tasha (Eng): backend note: downloads will be generated async for big traces. we'll queue job and show toast when ready. ok to show spinner + disabled download while generating.
Ibrahim (PM): analytics: track copy_permalink, export_initiated, export_ready. for export_ready include size_bytes and redaction flag.
Riley (A11y): also include aria-live confirmation text: 'Correlation ID copied' and 'Trace export ready: filename' when done. ensure dialog focus management for export options.
sam-bot: deploy #frontend/9012 succeeded — staging deploy queued. :rocket: 
Noah (Design): will update figma with desktop + mobile collapsed variants and post spec for ARIA states. tagging @Tasha and @Riley for final sign-off.
